en.topic_title: Number of missing in Nepal, China floods soars to nearly 3,000
en.topic_summary:
Rescuers in Nepal and China were still battling Saturday to locate thousands of people missing days after a deadly, tsunami-like wall of water and debris swept through the Himalayan region, engulfing villages.



A woman looks at photographs of the missing and dead following flash floods in Nepal, outside a hospital in Kathmandu on August 29, 2026. Photo: Prakash Mathema/AFP.
